default-applied.description: default path, authorized then acknowledged and applied

default-held.description: default path, decision held, nothing dispatched

default-held-revoked.description: default path, grant status revoked: held with grant_revoked

journal-applied.description: journal mode, authorized then applied (two checks)

journal-partial.description: journal mode, partial dispatch and partial observation

journal-lost-ack.description: journal mode, acknowledgement lost, attempt unknown

journal-lost-ack-closeout.description: lost acknowledgement, then reconcile appends a closeout

journal-reconciled-existing.description: retry after lost ack finds the effect (reconciled_existing)

journal-failed.description: journal mode, destination definitively rejected the effect

journal-effect-time-refusal.description: journal mode, grant unreadable at effect time: refusal

journal-held-revoked.description: journal mode, grant status revoked: held with the recomputable grant_revoked
